title: Office Cleaning Contract: Comparison of Tenders

headings.text: Office Cleaning Contract: Comparison of Tenders

key_sentences: Three compliant tenders were received by the closing date of 23 January.
Each tender was scored against the criteria published in the invitation to tender, with price weighted at 40%.
Prices were scored in proportion to the lowest compliant tender.
We recommend that the contract is awarded to Brightwell Services, which achieved the highest overall score.
Its price is £13,450 a year higher than the lowest tender, but its method statement is considerably stronger.
The current contract with the outgoing supplier ends on 31 March 2026 and cannot be extended.

rows: Award of the cleaning contract for Kingsgate House, 2026–2029

list_items.text: Corran Clean’s price depends on a staff turnover rate that looks optimistic.
Silverbirch would need six weeks to mobilise, which would delay the start to May.
All three bidders assume the current opening hours of the building.
i. Committee decision at the meeting of 19 February.
ii. Standstill period of ten days, then contract signature.
